reserveReview.rationale: Base Dollar's five launch branches are overcollateralized on-chain positions backed by WETH, wstETH, rETH, wrapped cbBTC, and cbETH. The configured Liquity V2 adapter owns current branch weights; this reviewed composition is only the reproducible point-in-time fallback and V9 asset taxonomy.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Base block 50,259,926 (hash 0x59ea75b489066fde1bb517c49ec1318ed4ac7f2b3bd27fcdf69d188e00003d53; 2026-08-21T10:46:39Z). ActivePool balances were valued with the same TroveManager protocol-price tuple used by the configured mechanism packet: WETH $27,389.46, wstETH $35,120.85, rETH $12,124.29, wrapped cbBTC $9,798.99, and cbETH $27,746.39, totaling $112,179.97. Percentages reproduce the adapter's normalized one-decimal slices and sum to 100.0%; live adapter output supersedes these dated weights.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No launch collateral branch is unclassified in this snapshot. Weights are borrower-driven and can change every block; the live adapter, not this dated fallback, is authoritative for current composition.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Collateral is held by on-chain ActivePool contracts rather than a conventional off-chain reserve custodian. cbBTC and cbETH retain Coinbase issuer/custody dependencies at the asset layer. The reviewed protocol sources do not establish legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation terms, so those safeguards remain unknown.
